categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hengda New Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of specialty base paper. Its main product lines include medical and food packaging base paper, industrial specialty base paper, and cigarette packaging base paper. The company focuses on mid-to-high-end markets, especially in medical and food single-use packaging paper, aligning with the 'paper replacing plastic' trend.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced R&D and manufacturing processes, holding 43 patents including 38 invention patents. It has developed proprietary formulations and process controls for medical and food packaging papers, ensuring properties like breathability, antibacterial features, waterproofing, and biocompatibility. Production follows a 'sales-driven' model with customized batch production, supported by continuous equipment upgrades and process innovations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the medical, food packaging, industrial specialty paper, and cigarette packaging sectors. The medical packaging paper is used in hospitals and consumer channels for products like sterile medical consumables and protective masks. Food packaging papers serve fast food and baking industries. The company serves mainly domestic customers with growing international sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Quzhou, Zhejiang Province, a major specialty paper production base. Domestic sales account for over 97% of revenue, with exports making up a small but growing portion. The company benefits from proximity to major logistics hubs in the Yangtze River Delta region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Hengda New Material operates in the midstream segment of the paper supply chain, producing specialty base paper that is further processed downstream by customers through coating, printing, and converting into final packaging products. It procures upstream raw materials like wood pulp and chemical additives, mainly relying on imports for wood pulp.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in specialty paper formulations and production technologies, focusing on medical and food packaging applications that meet environmental and regulatory standards. R&D projects include antibacterial, heat-sealable, and environmentally friendly papers. It aims to expand capacity, enhance product quality, and increase domestic substitution of imported materials through collaboration with research institutes and downstream partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of specialty base paper products to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model to maintain close customer relationships and provide integrated services. Revenue streams are based on product sales volume and pricing, with no subscription or licensing components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading producers in China's mid-to-high-end medical and food packaging base paper market, competing with other specialty paper manufacturers such as Xianhe Co., Wuzhou Special Paper, and Huabang Special Paper. It holds a strong market share domestically and competes on technology, product quality, and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.008 billion, a 15.99% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 68.46 million, down 21.88% from the previous year. The company has total assets of RMB 1.685 billion and equity of RMB 1.364 billion, indicating a mature mid-sized enterprise with steady revenue growth but some profit margin pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Hengda New Material emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced specialty base papers with superior functional properties tailored for medical and food packaging. Its products offer breathability, antibacterial protection, and environmental compliance, supporting the 'paper replacing plastic' trend. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, and a robust quality management system to differentiate itself in the mid-to-high-end market segment.
